what: Re-validation of the mu_max=0.6 gate under pFBA (deterministic fluxes), run on ts-02 (x86_64, 128 workers, ~18 min vs ~5 h local FBA).
determinism_fixed: Under FBA, PC mono diverged 1.795 (aarch64) vs 1.556 (x86_64); under pFBA both give 1.8627 -- all tested strains (AC/PC/BC/ER) identical to 4 decimals across platforms. dFBA is now reproducible on any machine.
verdict: pFBA changes nothing meaningful (0.767/0.294/0.179 vs 0.767/0.301/0.181) -- the mechanism arc is robust AND now deterministic/reproducible.
